def Saisie():
    b = False
    while not b:
        n = int(input('Donner N: '))
        b = n >= 10
    return n


def palindrome(ch):
    ch1 = ''
    for i in range(len(ch)):
        ch1 = ch[i] + ch1
    return ch1 == ch


def Suite_Palindromique(N):
    x = str(N)
    R = x + ','
    ok = palindrome(x)
    i = 1
    while not ok and i <= 11:
        y = ''
        for j in range(len(x)):
            y = x[j] + y
        S = int(y) + int(x)
        x = str(S)
        i += 1
        R += x + ","
        ok = palindrome(x)
    R = R[:len(R) - 1]
    if i > 11:
        R = 'Le calcul de 11 termes ne donne pas une suite palindromique pour ce nombre'
    return R


##############""pp##################
N = Saisie()
ch = Suite_Palindromique(N)
print(ch)
